purpose: Attribute the closed K=12 rebuild instability between independent-corpus variance and fit/architecture variance without reopening promotion or external-strength evidence.

training_data.source: Exact durable collection caches of failed rebuild members 1-12 only; no stability-bank state is training data.
training_data.ordinary_pool: All ordinary.train samples from members 1-12, exact-state deduplicated in member/sample order.
training_data.augmentation_pool: All augmentation.train + augmentation.holdout samples from members 1-12, exact-state deduplicated and excluding ordinary strong-state keys.
training_data.specialist_pool: All specialist.train + specialist.holdout samples from members 1-12, canonical unique-strong deduplication.
training_data.common_corpus_rule: Every pilot fit replica receives the exact same ordered ordinary/fullpool/specialist training corpora.

fit_design.route: postflop made_category>=TRIPS AND FOLD legal -> specialist; otherwise fullpool

interpretation.corpus_support_dominant: Shared-corpus broad mean-TV AND broad p95-TV are each at most 70% of the original-12 values on the identical fresh research bank.
interpretation.fit_architecture_dominant: Shared-corpus broad mean-TV AND broad p95-TV are each at least 90% of the original-12 values on the identical fresh research bank.

attribution_rule.note: These 70%/90% attribution bands are research heuristics frozen before pilot results; they are not promotion thresholds.

next_branch_rule.corpus_support_dominant: Design a new separately preregistered shared-corpus candidate with fresh training seeds and a never-observed promotion bank.
next_branch_rule.fit_architecture_dominant: Do not scale collection; investigate optimization/model/loss stability before another candidate.
next_branch_rule.mixed: Run a second factorial research pilot separating corpus and fit components before candidate construction.

exclusions: No member selection, dropping, or weighting.
No use of K=12 stability-bank states for training.
No claim that this research pilot is a deployable policy.
superseded_reason: Method review before any pilot execution found that pooling all 12 caches changes both corpus identity and corpus size, confounding common-corpus attribution with increased-data support. No V1 pilot result was observed.
